notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Repeat.
